title: Oakridge — Night Patrol (chapter-1 demo)
description: A night ring road around a dark city block, wet asphalt under green and teal neon, with a narrow street — the Cut — running through the middle of the block. You start on the south stretch beside your parked motorcycle; your partner waits on his bike ahead. Ride the marked beacons around the zone; when the call comes in, the last beacon is the chapel.
worldTexture: night, wet streets, green neon with a teal accent — cover mood, not photoreal
a patrol ring around one dark super-block; the tower over the block is skyline only
the player and their partner ride motorcycles; no other traffic exists
demo content for the mounts/companion/route engine slice — story flavor lives in this pack, not in the engine

mounts.label: Your motorcycle
mounts.prompt: Press E to ride your bike
mounts.mountedHint: On the bike. W opens the throttle, A and D steer, S brakes, E gets off.
mounts.srHint: Your motorcycle, parked at the kerb, key in.

checkpoints.label: Southwest corner
checkpoints.srHint: The first beacon, where the south stretch turns north.
checkpoints.text: Jax, over comms: "Keep it under the lamps, rook. The zone reads cleaner when it can see you coming."

checkpoints.label: Northwest corner
checkpoints.srHint: Second beacon, top of the west stretch.
checkpoints.text: Mal, to herself: "West side quiet. Reservoir fog rolling in over the rooftops again."

checkpoints.label: The Cut — south into the block
checkpoints.srHint: Third beacon, at the mouth of the narrow street through the middle of the block.
checkpoints.text: Jax: "Down the Cut. Middle of the block sees nothing but us and the relay light."

checkpoints.label: South mouth — east onto the stretch
checkpoints.srHint: Fourth beacon, where the Cut opens back onto the south road.
checkpoints.text: Mal: "Out of the canyon. Neon again. I could get used to this beat."

checkpoints.label: Southeast corner
checkpoints.srHint: Fifth beacon, bottom of the east stretch.
checkpoints.text: Dispatch, static-thin: "All units, zone four. Chapel relay is flickering. Probably weather. Hold your loops."

checkpoints.label: East stretch — the call
checkpoints.srHint: Sixth beacon, high on the east stretch — where the radio changes everything.
checkpoints.text: Dispatch, no static now: "Signal drop at the chapel relay. Body on the steps. Unit twelve — it's yours. Ride."

checkpoints.label: Oakridge Chapel — RESPOND
checkpoints.srHint: The destination: the chapel forecourt on the north rim, under the CHAPEL sign.

onComplete.text: The chapel steps. The relay above the door is dark — first time since it was bolted there — and at the foot of the steps, half in the gutter's green reflection, someone who is not getting up. Jax kills his engine behind you. Somewhere in the Church's far towers, a clock you cannot hear has already started counting down what is left of this body's mind. First patrol. First body. The zone was never quiet.

triggers.label: The south stretch
triggers.srHint: The patrol begins on the south stretch of the ring road.

trigger.text: Rain earlier; the asphalt still holds it. Your bike waits at the kerb, and ahead, Jax sits his own machine like he grew there. Patrol night. Ride the beacons, close the loop.
